technical-summary: The live placement planner treats the last helper as the tail and the others as heads. derive_manifest_live_policy now declines the policy, with the helper arrangement named, for layouts that are not heads followed by exactly one tail (flashnext-2xtx has no tail; -2xtx-rdna2-head weights its heads). flashnext-4gpu and -2xtx-rdna2-tail are unchanged.
user-summary-candidate: Live expert placement no longer switches on for layouts it was not built for, and says why.
